articles.summary: Offshore Technology: 3D Energi announces gas discovery at Charlemont-1 in Otway Basin. The company reported that the gas sample was successfully recovered from the Waarre C sandstone at a 2,571.2m MDRT. Related tickers mentioned: TDO.AX.
